profile.headline: System Software Engineer
profile.summary: Embedded system software professional with extensive and combined skills of development and integration.  Expertise in C/C++, IoT over BLE/Wi-Fi, embedded Linux, TCP/IP, cryptography and more. Experienced in digital broadcast with conditional access and video recording.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on Matter standard, which is ongoing protocol to communicate all devices in a local network, aka CHIP, running on a Wi-Fi device, making Thermostat application over the network. Also, leading the firmware for a wireless adapter allowing connection to the cloud and control from iOS/Android mobile devices. Control to achieve the best efficiency and performance over multi-zone heating and cooling system.

positions.title: Software Expert
positions.description: Developed full path of Set Top Box software. Frontend tuners (satellite, cable, terrestrial and IP), Demodulator, Demux, DVB/ATSC signaling, MPEG transport, H.264, Dolby AC3, HDMI/HDCP and graphic user interface.  Implemented Nagra CAS driver/application adaptation layer, 100% certified for all security requirements.  Implemented MPEG transport descrambling and M2M TDES data transfer for content recording and playback. Advanced DVR features like series recording, timeshift, trick play and file system.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Implemented Multimedia Home Platform (MHP) solution on multiple platforms. 100% certified Nagra and Irdeto conditional access system. Designed and built up secured boot and software update over the air.
